_owner: PA (trader outpost life): customers and drinkers. Sections: customer, drinker, one per trader (order, trader_reply), one per bar (order, barkeep_reply, cutoff, local, stronger). Placeholders: {name}, {other}, {place}.

idle: I told the captain twenty minutes. It's been forty.
Where did I put the list?
Nice to breathe air that isn't ours for a change.
I should have brought a bag.
Is that the same mechanic as last time? Still fixing that thing.
talk: Just looking. Shopping's for people with money.
You off one of the ships too?
Don't mind me. I'm waiting on my crew.
The diner's better than it looks.
Heard the lanes are rough this week. Watch yourself.
queue_give_up: Some of us have a ship to catch.
convoy: That's the convoy. Good timing for once.
chat: They've got the good oxygen tanks in again.

conversations.opener: Is it me or is the lift slower today?

replies: A bag of something. I'll find out what later.

order: Two ration packs and whatever's cheapest that floats.
Flares. The ones that still burn when you drop them.
What's the least I can pay for a medkit and still feel good about it?
Do you still buy bear hide? My captain says you do. My captain says a lot of things.
A tin of beans and a deck of cards. It's going to be a long trip.
Oxygen tanks. Four. No, five. Our engineer breathes a lot.
Anything new on the charts for the yellow lanes?
trader_reply: Sensible choice. Don't tell anyone I said so.
Pay at the till, dear. The turrets don't take tips.
Wrapped up and ready. Mind the step on your way out.
There you are. Bring yourself back in one piece.
Lovely. I'd have picked the same.

order: Fish and chips, and don't skimp on the chips.
Is the special still on, or did the chalk fall off again?
Something hot. I've been on ration bars for nine days.
Can I get the ramen without whatever that is floating in it?
Our cook quit. Can I just eat here until we find another one?
Is there any chowder, or is that just the name on the sign?
trader_reply: Coming off the pass now. Mind, it's hot.
Eat slow. It took longer to make than you took to earn it.
Sit anywhere. I'll shout.
You'll get what's hot. Everything's hot.

order: Anything that grows in a closet with one lamp?
My tomato plant died again. I'd like another one to disappoint.
Something for the bugs. They've taken the whole tray.
Seeds for something that tastes like fruit. Any fruit.
Our botanist wants a watering can. The last one got used as a helmet.
Is the honey from your own bees?
trader_reply: Talk to it every morning. It won't answer, but it'll notice.
Wrap that up before the bees see it.
Low light and forgiveness. Same as last time.
Water it less than you think. Everyone drowns them.

order: What's biting today?
I need bait that doesn't smell like the inside of a boot.
Is that pond actually stocked, or is that a rumour you started?
My line snapped on something big. I want a thicker one. Out of spite.
How long did it take you to catch the one on the wall?
A tin of worms and a box of hooks. The small hooks.
trader_reply: Everything bites if you're patient. Most people aren't.
Worms in the tin, lures on the peg. Don't mix them up.
Small hooks, big patience. That's all there is to it.
Stocked. Mostly. Don't ask about the koi.

order: I want the vest that stops things. Not the one that looks like it does.
How many magazines is too many?
My crew's heading into the yellow. What's the one thing we'll forget?
Firing pins. I know, I know.
Do I get a discount if I don't ask any stupid questions?
Magboots. My last pair walked off without me in them.
trader_reply: Pins. Everyone forgets the pins.
Buy the helmet. Then buy the other helmet.
Sign here, don't die, come back for more.
Next.

order: Is this core supposed to be humming?
I'd like a part for a machine I can't pronounce.
Our scientist sent me with a list. Half of it's in another language.
Is that slime extract alive? It moved.
The best power cell you've got. The engineer said the best one. Twice.
What's the difference between the blue crystal and the other blue crystal?
trader_reply: Humming is fine. If it starts singing, come back.
Hold it by the handle. The handle. Thank you.
Tell your scientist the answer's still no, but here's the part.
Don't lick it. People always want to lick it.

order: My suit makes a noise when I turn left.
Can you make this thing lighter? I walk like a fridge.
I'd like the good chassis. Yes, I know I haven't been measured.
The seal on the left glove keeps letting go.
Have you got plating that isn't safety orange?
A jetpack module. My captain says no. My captain isn't here.
trader_reply: Stand on the mark and lift your arms. Higher.
That noise is your warranty leaving.
Bench install's free. Corridor installs cost fingers.
Hold still. Breathe in. Now don't.

order: I was told to ask for the thing in the grey case.
Nobody sent me. I came on my own. Completely.
How much for the pistol that doesn't make a sound?
One of the sealed crates. What's in it? Right. That's the point.
You don't know me and I don't know you. Right?
Smoke grenades. Three. It's for a party.
trader_reply: Never seen you before in my life. Pay up.
No receipts, no returns, no questions from you either.
Stock's limited. So is my patience.
Don't open it here.

order: Whatever's cheapest and wet.
A bottle of the hooch for the road. Don't tell my captain.
Has anyone asked for me? No? Good.
Start a tab. I'll be good for it by Tuesday.
A meat pie and something to wash it down.
trader_reply: Cash first. Your face isn't a tab.
That one'll put hair on your hull.
Here. Don't spill it on my bar.
Next.

order: It's only a little bit shot.
I'd like the cheapest way to not die today.
Can you look at this? No, lower. Lower.
Do you take payment in parts? Not my parts.
Just stitch it. I'll stop bleeding on the way home.
Is that a real heart in the fridge? Is it for sale?
trader_reply: On the table. Don't touch anything shiny.
You'll live. That'll be extra.
Walk-ins welcome. Crawl-ins pay the same.
Press here. Harder. Good. Now pay.

order: How long before I stop feeling the arm?
I want eyes that see in the dark. And maybe a little further.
My last ripperdoc left a screw in me. Can you find it?
Does chrome itch? Mine itches.
Give me something that makes me faster than whoever's chasing me.
The blades that fold into the arm. How much?
trader_reply: Sit. Breathe. You won't want to watch this part.
It's supposed to itch. That means it's settling in.
Mirror's over there. Take your time.
Everyone asks for the blades. Nobody asks what they weigh.

talk_0: Just got here. Give me a minute.
talk_1: Pull up a stool. It's a good night.
Buy me the next one and I'll tell you a secret.
talk_2: Have you met my friend? No? Neither have I. Hello!
I love this place. I love everyone in it.
I've got a story about a carp. You'll want to sit down.
talk_3: Who are you? You look... you look nice.
The floor keeps moving. Tell it to stop.
stage_1: This place is alright. I like this place.
Another one of the... yes. That one.
Best seat in the house, this.
Nobody talk to me about work.
stage_2: Who wants to hear about the time I punched a carp?
I love you all. Not you. I'm still deciding about you.
You know what? You know what. Never mind.
stage_3: Where did the floor go? It was right here.
Is it hot in here or is it the lamp?
I'm fine. Is the room fine?
sing: Oh the void is wide and my ship is small...
Ninety-nine cans of fuel on the wall, ninety-nine cans of fuel...
And the carp came up from the deep, deep black...
handed: Oh, don't mind if I do.
Cheers! To you. To us. To this glass.
handed_gossip: Did you hear? Somebody lost a whole ship out past the yellow line. A whole ship!
They say the pirates are getting bolder. Everyone knows that. I'm just telling you.
The convoy was late again. Late! Again!
handed_refuse: That smells wrong. You drink it.
No thanks. I've seen what that does.
wake: What time is it? Never mind. Bed.
leave: Right. Ship. Which way's the ship?
violence: Grab the bottles! I mean, get down!

conversations.opener: You know what the problem with the void is?
I'm going to buy a ship. A big one.
Did I ever tell you about my first captain?
This one's on me. Next one's on you.

idle: Everyone's armed in the red zone. That's why it's polite here.
My captain thinks I'm out resupplying. I am. Slowly.
The turrets only shoot rude people. Beautiful system. No survivors... I mean, no complaints.
Shore leave's four days. Two getting here, one drinking, one regretting it.
You didn't see me here. I'm not here. Nobody's ever here.
attacked: Ha! In the Undertow? Vex would skin you if I were worth skinning.
Save it for the docks, friend. In here we drink.
talk: Everyone's armed in the red zone. That's why it's polite here.
My captain thinks I'm out resupplying. I am. Slowly.

order: Dram, the usual.
Dram. Something that burns.
Whiskey. Don't bother wiping the glass.
barkeep_reply: Sit down before you fall down.
Here. Don't spill it on my bar.
cutoff: You're done. Go sleep it off.
local: Don't look at the lounge. Don't ever look at the lounge.
Best bar in the red. Only bar in the red.
The man in the lounge bought me a drink once. I'm still paying for it.

order: Roux, a pint and whatever's in the pot.
A beer, Roux. And bread. Lots of bread.
Something cold to wash down the special.
barkeep_reply: You'll have it when it's poured.
cutoff: You're done, love. Sleep it off.
local: The chowder soaks it right up. That's science.
Best food on the inner ring. Only food on the inner ring.
Roux's cooking would bring back the dead.

order: Coffee. Coffee first.
Right. Coffee.
Come on, machine. Just one cup.
stronger: Enough coffee. Where's the good stuff?
local: Shift's over. Nobody say the word convoy.
My back's done. It's been done since Tuesday.
Sarge wants the east yard cleared by morning. Sarge can clear it.
